build_regime: Matched production settings: all-static, ohm-defaults, ThinLTO, one codegen unit, dev channel, debug1, same physical build paths and stock Rust1.99.0. No PGO; not an exact reconstruction of the published stage1-built release.
cargo_version_scope: Both actual -Vv outputs are byte-identical and omit commit fields. The common checkout HEAD is source provenance, not an assertion that a commit appears in the emitted version.

correctness_tests.scope: collector controls; no new Cargo testsuite claim

historical_scope: Independent confirmation of current PR178 restack on a new Genoa host, with original uv/SDK6 and native-to-first-check endpoint; historical Milan result remains separately anchored. SDK12 already includes this behavior; this is not an SDK12 speedup claim.
independence: New production-settings binaries and fresh native seeds, reverse producer order, no pooling with the earlier normal-build n=1 diagnostic. Statistical unit is a restored-state pair, conditional on one new native seed per variant, not twelve independent native builds.
maintenance_decoder: Repeated TimersMonotonic values are preserved in order; duplicate scalar, unknown and missing properties reject.

pair_reservation_rule.during_pair: Any new trigger/start/exit or active heavy service at native-command boundaries invalidates the entire block; CPU accounting is retained without treating delayed accounting as a new service cycle.

preflight: Dedicated charlie-ohm-loader-perf-1024; complete native-only seeds and natural provenance; 210-second heavy-service admission before each complete pair, with service-cycle checks outside each native stopwatch. Original load averages remain recorded; no new generic numerical CPU-occupancy gate is claimed.
primary_metric: Native cargo check wall time including all compiler/build-script children, excluding restoration/verification.

restoration.inventory: Every unique device/inode is hashed once per inventory; all path/metadata/link rows retained, with size, nanosecond mtime/ctime, mode, link-count and inode identity consistency checked.
restoration.method: Checksum rsync without inplace/link-dest, full independent-copy fallback, mandatory full content/mode/nanosecond-mtime/symlink/hardlink inventory match before each timed command. External hardlinks force copy before inode metadata updates.

retention: All 24 samples retained. No interim effect inspection, early stopping, optional sample extension, or exclusions. Any failed command or input/state integrity failure invalidates the batch and is retained.
scope: Full unchanged uv workspace; default build profiles and incremental behavior. No test executables run.
source_adaptations: Raw command/exit/elapsed receipt immediately after subprocess return and before fallible interpretation; original native stopwatch and statistics unchanged.
Prospective maintenance admission outside complete pairs and strict same-service-cycle checks outside each native stopwatch.
Persistent task-owned supervisor with file-backed stdio and passive notification.

stop_rules.operational_failure: retain all raw data; no effect inspection; restore native parent and stop
